_comment: DECLARED HARDENED BASELINE for Meridian (the committed 'this is good' posture from Modules 10-12). This file IS the decision log: when you bless a sanctioned change you edit it here and commit with who/why. Thresholds are chosen by the operator and justified inline below. drift-detect.py diffs the OBSERVED posture (data/observed.json) against this and reports per-fact deltas, not a score.

_thresholds._krbtgt_justification: MITRE ATT&CK mitigation M1015 (Active Directory Configuration) recommends rotating krbtgt regularly; 180 days is the common operational ceiling. Stricter (e.g. 90) is defensible — set it to your tolerance. A krbtgt older than this is standing T1558.001 (Golden Ticket) risk and scores as drift.

_kerberoastable_comment: Accounts with a servicePrincipalName that are user (not computer) objects and RC4-eligible. Hardened state: none (all service accounts migrated to gMSA / long random passwords per Module 10). A NEW SPN appearing here is drift -> T1558.003.
_unconstrained_comment: Principals with TRUSTED_FOR_DELEGATION (uAC & 0x80000). Hardened: none (svc-backup converted to constrained delegation per Module 08 M-004).
_dangerous_aces_comment: Non-default GenericWrite / WriteDacl / WriteOwner / AllExtendedRights ACEs on privileged objects. Each entry: {principal, right, on_object}. Hardened: none (the svc-deploy GenericWrite on IT-Admins that drove PATH-001 step 3 was removed per Module 08 M-002).

privileged_group_rosters._comment: The EXACT expected membership of each privileged group. Any unexpected member is drift -> T1098 (Account Manipulation). Any expected member missing is also drift (someone removed a needed admin).

krbtgt._comment: Days since krbtgt password was last set (simulated clock). Hardened state: freshly rotated.
